nodes.name: launchpad-ts
nodes.summary: Shared vendor template catalog (400+ personas, 160+ skills, spec-kit) that the Hackathon Strategist scaffolds from and references instead of duplicating.

nodes.name: Anthropic SDK (Claude)
nodes.summary: Anthropic SDK used to run the LLM personas; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is required for persona runs.

nodes.name: OmniRoute
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (localhost:2016/v1) used as the primary provider in development; resolves model 'auto'.

nodes.name: LiteLLM
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (localhost:4000/v1) supported as an alternative provider.

nodes.name: TypeScript
nodes.summary: Strict-mode TypeScript (Node >= 22, pnpm, ESM) is the engine stack; orchestration is plain TS with no agent framework.

nodes.name: pnpm
nodes.summary: Exclusive package manager for the repo; global installs (npm -g / pnpm add -g) are strictly prohibited.

nodes.name: React 19
nodes.summary: React 19 powers the optional control-room UI, streaming the event bus live.

nodes.name: Vite 8
nodes.summary: Vite 8 build tool for the control-room app, kept consistent with the launchpad-ts base.

nodes.name: Tailwind CSS v4
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first, dark-mode-first with a cyan-400 accent) used for control-room styling.

nodes.name: Playwright
nodes.summary: Browser automation library earmarked as the Phase-5 hardening fallback for JS-rendered event websites that resist cheerio parsing.

nodes.name: Claude Code
nodes.summary: AI coding agent that implemented the bulk of the system and authored the HANDOFF.md entry log.

nodes.name: Enterprise Architect
nodes.summary: Architect agent that produced the spec-first scaffold: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, spec.md, AGENTS.md, RUBRIC.md and the .agents/ persona catalog.

nodes.name: Cursor Hackathon SAIT — May 2026
nodes.summary: The first real-event run of the Strategist (config/events/cursor-hackathon-sait.json), completed headless in Phase 5.

nodes.name: ACME Logistics
nodes.summary: Example sponsor in config/events/example.json with a Supply Chain AI challenge track and a $10,000 + incubation prize.

nodes.name: Consensus-gated deliberation loop is the differentiator
nodes.summary: The differentiator is the iterative, consensus-gated deliberation loop — a decision flow deliberately not a one-shot idea picker. A run that only prints a winner without the loop, the rubric Judge, or a live transcript is not the product.

nodes.name: Evidence-first what-to-build decision
nodes.summary: The highest-leverage hackathon decision — what to build — is usually made intuitively in the first hour; the Strategist replaces that guess with a research + deliberation problem grounded in cited evidence.

nodes.name: Headless-first: the CLI run is the product
nodes.summary: The CLI run is the product; the control room is a view on the same event stream. No UI must produce identical artifacts, so decision logic never lives in the UI.

nodes.name: Evidence over opinion
nodes.summary: Every claim a persona makes carries a citation and a confidence stamp; fabricated sources are a correctness bug, not a style issue.

nodes.name: Weighted scoring model (25/20/20/15/10/10)
nodes.summary: The default weighted decision model scores Problem-Solution Fit 25%, Feasibility 20%, Innovation 20%, Stakeholder Alignment 15%, Data Leverage 10%, and Demo-ability 10%; total = sum(score x weight), with ranks from normalized totals and per-event overrides allowed.

nodes.name: Judge approves only at >= 6/10 on every criterion
nodes.summary: The Judge approves a candidate only if every criterion scores >= 6/10 and no gating rule fails; otherwise it returns a Revise verdict with specific, actionable FeedbackItems.

nodes.name: The loop always terminates
nodes.summary: The deliberation loop must terminate: unanimous approval, or budgets.maxRounds exhausted which escalates to a human with a dissent log — it never forces fake consensus and never refines forever.

nodes.name: Runtime personas are markdown files
nodes.summary: Each persona is a markdown file in .agents/personas/ whose frontmatter + body is loaded as the LLM system prompt, so personas are editable without touching code.

nodes.name: Plain-TypeScript orchestration, no agent framework
nodes.summary: Orchestration uses no agent framework — plain TypeScript with an event bus, stage machine, and budget governor — so loop control and artifacts stay deterministic and testable.

nodes.name: Confidence stamps: high / medium / low
nodes.summary: Every ResearchFinding and scored statement carries a confidence stamp — high = directly observed or quoted, medium = inferred, low = assumption and must be labeled 'assumption'.

nodes.name: Gateway CCR compression constraint
nodes.summary: OmniRoute and LiteLLM compress user messages larger than ~800 chars into [CCR retrieve] stubs, so all persona context must live in the system prompt rather than the user message.

nodes.name: Single-iteration stage machine with a looping deliberation
nodes.summary: Stages run in order ingest -> research -> synthesize -> ideate -> [deliberation loop] -> finalize -> artifacts; only the deliberation loop iterates, and a non-converging round escalates immediately.

edges.description: spec.md is the 'what' that implements the architect brief in prompt.md ('Requirements originate in prompt.md').
IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md is the detailed engineering spec ('how') that implements the 'what' defined in spec.md.
The base scaffold (package.json, tsconfig, Tailwind/React/Vite conventions) is copied from the launchpad-ts template.
The Judge owns the event's scoring sheet and applies the RUBRIC.md weights criterion-by-criterion.
The Orchestrator enforces the stage machine, budget governor, gates, and termination rules codified in the orchestration rule.
The orchestration rule's round protocol (debate -> refine & score -> reviewer assessment -> loop control) is operationalized by the debate-protocol skill.
The data-analysis skill is explicitly the procedure for the Data Analyst persona (profiling + leverage map).
The web-ingest skill normalizes event website content that the Event Intelligence Analyst then extracts facts from.
The Decision Lead executes the refine-and-score step of the debate-protocol round sequence, applying feedback and human directives.
The Devil's Advocate performs the critique step defined by the debate-protocol round.
HANDOFF.md attributes the spec-first scaffold (incl. spec.md) to the enterprise-architect agent.
HANDOFF.md attributes IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to the enterprise-architect agent.
HANDOFF.md attributes AGENTS.md to the enterprise-architect agent.
HANDOFF.md attributes RUBRIC.md to the enterprise-architect agent.
The HANDOFF.md entry log is written by claude-code sessions (most entries attributed to claude-code).
ACME Logistics is the concrete example sponsor (challenge track + prize) the Sponsor & Stakeholder Analyst persona illustrates its stated-vs-inferred citation rule with.
The Cursor Hackathon SAIT May 2026 run is the first real-event instance of spec.md's primary goal: a headless run on a real hackathon.
